text:
Stop leaking money through your bank account.

Most of us lose dozens of dollars every month on services we no longer use. The easiest way to fix this is a five-minute subscription audit on the first of every month. Open your banking app, scroll through your recurring charges, and cancel anything you haven't touched in the last 30 days.

It’s not about deprivation; it’s about reclaiming your resources and your mental space. Small, consistent checks like this add up to significant savings over time.
